title: 40px form-field baseline
lede: Default Input, NativeSelect, SelectTrigger, Button, and FormCombobox triggers now share a 40px height so a text field, select, and action in the same row line up without per-page overrides.

stats.n: Name input, Location select, Create, and Cancel all measured 36px before and 40px after.
Name input and Primary Area select measured 36px before and 40px after.
size=sm/xs and icon-sm/icon-xs stay compact. SelectTrigger size=sm stays 32px in dense tables.

sections.heading: Form rows
sections.note: Matched Cursor IDE Chromium captures at 1372×1160 CSS pixels, ADMIN, dark appearance, authenticated local Preview at 127.0.0.1:3000. HEAD f7733f57. Before photos used the prior primitive-interaction dirty tree with field defaults still h-9. After photos apply the 40px field baseline. Next.js overlay chrome was hidden on the after kiosk/profile frames and is not part of the claimed change.

pairs.title: Kiosk add row
pairs.sub: Input, Select, and default Buttons in one row.
pairs.beforeCap: Name, Location, Create, and Cancel sat at 36px. They lined up with each other, but they sat under the 40px operational target.
pairs.afterCap: The same row is 40px. The text field, select, and actions still share one height.

pairs.title: Profile identity fields
pairs.sub: Stacked inputs and a select using primitive defaults.
pairs.beforeCap: Name and Primary Area rendered at the shared 36px field default.
pairs.afterCap: The same fields are 40px and line up with the existing 40px Change photo, Remove, Reset, and Saved controls.

changes.was: Input, NativeSelect, and default SelectTrigger were h-9 (36px). FormCombobox was locked to h-9 so it would not misalign those fields. Many pages papered over this with className=h-10.
changes.now: Those primitives default to h-10. FormCombobox inherits the default Button height. A form row lines up without a local override.

changes.was: Default Button was h-9; size=lg was already h-10, so raising the default alone would collapse the size ladder.
changes.now: Default Button is h-10. size=lg is h-11 (44px) so it stays distinct. sm, xs, icon-sm, and icon-xs remain density exceptions.

changes.h: Local h-9 holdouts follow the baseline
changes.was: ItemInfoTab QR entry, Onboarding bulk-role Select, the booking wizard Link-to-event chip, and non-compact ClaimShiftAction still forced 36px.
changes.now: Those controls inherit or set 40px. Compact ClaimShiftAction stays h-8.
